sources: Detailed CEN 01/2026 (application and fee rules: ₹500 for all other candidates with ₹400 refunded after appearing in CBT 1, ₹250 for SC, ST, ex-servicemen, female, transgender, minority and EBC candidates fully refunded after appearing; live photograph capture; signature in running handwriting; one candidate, one RRB, one application): https://rrbsecunderabad.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/detail-cen-01-2026-eng-.pdf
Official RRB websites (rrbcdg.gov.in and rrb.indianrailways.gov.in) for city intimation, e-call letters and answer keys
RDSO Psychology Candidate's Corner (rdso.indianrailways.gov.in) for CBAT sample material and FAQs

admitCard.where: Links on the official RRB websites (rrbcdg.gov.in and your RRB's site). No call letter is sent by post.
admitCard.when: Exam city and date intimation about 10 days before your exam date; e-call letter download from about 4 days before
steps: Open your RRB's official website and open the exam city and date intimation link about 10 days before your exam date. SC/ST candidates who opted for the free sleeper-class train pass also get their travel authority here.
Download the e-call letter from about 4 days before the exam and print it clearly.
Check your name, roll number, centre, date and shift against your application.
Write the self-declaration paragraph on the e-call letter at the venue, in front of the invigilator, in your own running handwriting.
carry: The same original photo ID you registered with (Aadhaar preferred)
A colour passport photograph not older than two months
admitCard.note: Electronic devices, calculators, watches, bags and stationery are banned inside; pens are provided. Helpdesk for applications: rrb.help@csc.gov.in, 0172-565-3333, 9592-001-188.

answerKey.summary: After each CBT the RRBs publish your question paper, responses and the provisional answer key, and open an objection window of roughly one week (for example, the ALP CEN 01/2025 CBT 2 key was open from 5 August to 12 August 2026).
steps: Open the answer key link on the RRB website and log in with your application credentials.
View your question paper, your responses and the provisional answer key.
File objections online before the window closes, paying the fee per question by card, UPI or net banking.
The RRBs' decision on objections is final, and no representation is entertained after the window closes.
answerKey.fee: ₹50 plus bank charges per question. The fee is refunded if your objection is found valid.
answerKey.note: The fee is credited back only to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account, the same rule that applies to the application fee refund.

result.summary: Results are published RRB-wise on the official RRB websites as PDF lists of roll numbers with normalised cutoff marks by category.

stages.what: Screening only. Shortlists candidates for CBT 2 at 15 times the vacancies. For Technician posts, the single CBT result shortlists candidates for document verification at 1:1 of vacancies.
The Part A result shortlists candidates for the CBAT at 8 times the vacancies. Part B is a qualifying trade test.

Held in English and Hindi only, with no negative marking and T-scores battery-wise. You need a minimum T-score of 42 in each battery, with no category relaxation. You must carry the Self-Screening Medical Declaration Report (Annexures VIII A and VIII B of the CEN), signed by a general physician and an eye specialist of a central or state government hospital or medical college; without it you are not allowed to appear. From CEN 01/2026 the final merit gives 50% weight to CBT 2 Part A and 50% to the CBAT.

Original certificates with two sets of self-attested photocopies are checked, and the railway medical examination follows (A-1 for ALP, B-1/A-3/B-2/C-1 for Technician posts). Missing the DV date or failing the medical forfeits the candidature, though a one-time medical appeal with prescribed charges is allowed.

result.scorecard: Your individual score card is viewable by logging in on the RRB website with your registration number and date of birth.
